hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: 44b FIT with shared station Action transport
inputs.revision: EmberBSD 44b863992e8aec80fe660cbc50376932deaa04f9; same FIT bytes as the prior RAM probe, now written to NOR with the candidate root. The previous NOR FIT was replaced; SPL was retained.

inputs.name: Candidate 10 MiB LittleFS network root
inputs.revision: Built from OS e04ddc0046bcd3a7b18ec4ef361200413d51778b plus source-refresh log fix 09a88d10264c4e969a06efef3c4fad77f39e6caf; SDK source-aware refresh 7a09e684793c54e7c1e313bb0acbd611623ec41a; Ports fb64a41f2132a4e9f92e5ee417ed9e396219c84c including WPA fix bd34723babd9cd45816f8b79724f4908f3f99ca5. The WPA supplicant object was compiled from the prepared WPA 2.12 source and final console-tools link succeeded.

scenario: After a combined FIT and LittleFS write to NOR with SPL retained, ordinary POWER-boot the image. Check pinned-key SSH and SAE/PMF/IPv4. At the initial AP, issue one neighbor_rep_request and one wnm_bss_query 0. Run a connected scan and station-initiated ROAM to the compatible alternate AP, then issue the same pair there. Capture supplicant DEBUG output through a verified temporary syslog sink, restore INFO/timestamp 0 and remove the temporary sink.
expected: Both APs advertise RRM and BTM; Neighbor Report requests yield parsed reports and each BTM query receives a peer response while SAE/PMF and IPv4 remain available.
observed: An ordinary NOR boot reached OpenSBI, U-Boot, kernel and the LittleFS root on flash1, then login. Pinned-key SSH succeeded; WPA reported COMPLETED with SAE, PMF=1 and IPv4. At the initial AP, capability 0x1c11 had RRM bit 12 set, RRM Enabled Capabilities IE 70 had length 5, and Extended Capabilities BTM bit 19 was set. neighbor_rep_request token 1 returned four parsed RRM-NEIGHBOR-REP-RECEIVED entries. The BTM query TX status correlated cookie 2, generation 1, category 10/action 6, token 1, ack=0 (unconfirmed); no peer response arrived in its 12-second window. A connected scan preserved the association, and ROAM moved to the requested alternate AP. That AP also advertised RRM and BTM capabilities. neighbor_rep_request token 2 returned three parsed RRM-NEIGHBOR-REP-RECEIVED entries. The BTM query TX status correlated cookie 4, generation 4, category 10/action 6, token 1, ack=0 (unconfirmed); no peer response or incoming BTM Request arrived in its 12-second window. After both pairs, WPA remained COMPLETED with SAE/PMF=1 and IPv4, and pinned-key SSH remained available. The verified DEBUG sink received the nonce; syslog configuration bytes were restored, logging returned to INFO/timestamp 0, and the temporary sink was removed.

measurements.name: initial-ap-btm-query-tx-status
measurements.unit: cookie 2, generation 1, category 10/action 6, token 1, ack=0 unconfirmed

measurements.name: post-roam-ap-btm-query-tx-status
measurements.unit: cookie 4, generation 4, category 10/action 6, token 1, ack=0 unconfirmed

measurements.name: post-roam-ap-btm-observation-window
measurements.unit: seconds; no peer response or incoming BTM Request observed

limits: Both APs advertised RRM/Neighbor Report and BTM capability, and both Neighbor Report requests returned parsed entries. This is one bounded run on one sample and does not establish repeated behavior or AP-initiated transition reliability.

Each BTM query produced a correlated TX completion, but firmware provides no peer ACK indication; ack=0 is unconfirmed, not a negative ACK. No peer response was observed in either 12-second window, and no incoming BTM Request was observed in the post-roam window.
The run does not establish a completed BTM peer exchange or full IEEE 802.11k/v behavior, PMF replay/forgery resistance, throughput or sustained reliability.
Private logs, credentials, host keys, network identifiers and local paths are not published.
